author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices up and down, a marching beat, finding D, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with an old marching action song.

classes.title: Up, down and halfway
classes.goal: Listen and move: stand tall for up, crouch for down, bend for halfway.

mathTarget.parentLine: Up, down, and halfway in the middle, with the body

classes.parentPrompt: Stand together; stretch tall on 'up', crouch on 'down', bend halfway on 'halfway'.
classes.childAction: Up: stand tall. Down: crouch low. Halfway: bend in the middle.
classes.bridge: The tune marches up the hill to the right, then back down to the left.

intro.caption: Up the hill, down the hill
intro.parentCue: stand up together and get ready to move

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: up, down and halfway with the music.

classes.title: March with the Duke
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap for every marching step while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Left, right, left, right: even steps that keep coming

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each step: left, right, left, right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one marching boot: left, right, up the hill.

intro.caption: Left, right, march!
intro.parentCue: say left, right on each beat

games.caption: Oh, the grand old Duke
games.parentCue: Say 'left, right' softly with each step

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a marching beat.

classes.title: Find D, the Duke's key
classes.goal: Find the special note D by using the two black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits around it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the two black keys, then down into the gap between them.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys and press D, right in between.
classes.bridge: D is the Duke between two black guards, one on each side.

intro.caption: Where does D live?
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding D between the two black keys.

classes.title: D at the top of the hill
classes.goal: Find D low down and high up and hear that they match.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note lives in two places: low left, high right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch for the low D, stretch up tall for the high D, saying 'D' each time.
classes.childAction: Hop from low D to high D: bottom, then top of the hill.
classes.bridge: Low D is the bottom of the hill; high D waits at the top.

intro.caption: D lives at the bottom and top
intro.parentCue: point to both Ds, low then high

games.caption: Up at the top of the hill
games.parentCue: Point right, to the high side, together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same note, low and high.

classes.title: Echo the Duke
classes.goal: Hold two or three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a short line of sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: The Duke calls an order; the soldier calls it right back.

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: sing 'Duke of York', let your child copy

games.caption: Duke of York: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Point to each lit key, nice and slow

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Up, up; down, down
classes.goal: Echo a pattern that climbs up and one that goes down, like the soldiers.

mathTarget.parentLine: One pattern goes up, its partner goes down

classes.parentPrompt: Stretch up tall for the up pattern; crouch down low for the down pattern.
classes.childAction: Play the up pattern, then the down pattern, and move with it.
classes.bridge: Going right is marching up the hill; going left is marching down.

intro.caption: When they were up, up!
intro.parentCue: stretch up tall, then crouch down together

games.caption: Up they go: C, E, G
games.parentCue: Lift your hand as the notes go up

games.caption: Down they go: D, B, G
games.parentCue: Lower your hand as the notes go down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: patterns going up and going down.

classes.title: Three Ds for the soldiers
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play D at its moments, counting three Ds.

mathTarget.parentLine: 'He had ten thousand' starts with three Ds: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; hold up one, two, three fingers as your child plays each D.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, then play D: one, two, three!
classes.bridge: Three Ds are three soldiers in a row: one, two, three.

intro.caption: Wait, wait, now it's D!
intro.parentCue: hands in lap until the D comes

games.caption: Three soldiers: D, D, D
games.parentCue: Show one finger for each D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and counting three.

classes.title: Two friends: D and C
classes.goal: Hear the difference between D and C and play each one when it comes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: is it D or is it C?

classes.parentPrompt: Point to D or C just before it comes, then let your child press it.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose D or C, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys; C is next door, on the left.

intro.caption: Two friends: D and C
intro.parentCue: touch D, then C, saying their names

games.caption: Up nor down: D, then C
games.parentCue: Say each name as your child presses

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing D and C and taking turns.

classes.title: March together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together at full speed, sharing one marching beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players marching to one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play your blue keys and smile; if your child misses a note, keep marching on.
classes.childAction: Play your D and C notes while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: We march side by side, the same boots on the same beat.

intro.caption: Ready, soldiers? Let's march!
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Parade for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear its two parts: the march, then up and down.

mathTarget.parentLine: First the march up the hill, then the up-and-down game

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; sit up tall on 'up' and hunch low on 'down' as you play.
classes.childAction: Play your notes to the end, then march a big bow.
classes.bridge: Part one climbs the hill; part two jumps up, down and halfway.

intro.caption: A parade for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song in two parts.
